description: This PHP file defines a class 'updateEndDate' that acts as a logic hook in SuiteCRM to automatically update the project's end date when a related task's end date exceeds the current project end date.

classes.name: updateEndDate
classes.description: A logic hook class used to update the project end date based on task end date changes.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method invoked during the logic hook to compare task end date and project end date, updating the project if necessary.
